Class BundledLicenseTexts

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.license.download.BundledLicenseTexts
public final class BundledLicenseTexts extends Object
A curated table of well-known license URLs whose content is available as a text bundled with the plugin, so that the plugin does not have to request them from the license host.

The table is the resource "META-INF/licenses/bundled-license-urls.properties". Every entry maps one exact URL, without scheme and without a leading www., to a BundledLicenseTexts.Kind and the id of a bundled license, which is the directory name under META-INF/licenses/. It is a URL to text mapping and not a URL to identity mapping: it says "this URL serves this document", not "the license of this project is X".

Since:
2.8.0
